record_scope_reconstruction: Radio Azadi reports an access-road obstruction affecting Aqina cargo after the fall of Andkhoy. Provincial council source describes Afghan defensive lines about ten kilometres from port and Taliban obstruction of the road to Jowzjan/Aqina; this is not precise evidence that the formal international gate itself was closed.

source_checks.finding: Dari text names Aqina, Andkhoy, a defensive position near oil installations, and Taliban road obstruction; no exact roadblock point.
